svg.desc: A ray · q = 10 · H = 10x − y = 4 · parent P7 → child C9 The old optimum on this parent slice fails the added runner. The new optimum lies inside a two-dimensional old face, on a new child edge. Keeping only old parent edges misses 17/35 and 18/35, so it fails to recover every maximizer even though six others survive. Final speeds: 0, 1, 10, 11, 12, 13, 23, 25, with reference 0. Three-dimensional views scale z by two; the section uses separate time and separation axes.
